name: Stock and Flow Modeling
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Pemodelan akumulasi sumber daya (*Stocks*), laju aliran masuk (*Inflows*), dan aliran keluar (*Outflows*)
source_original.inputs: Kapasitas awal, laju penambahan, laju penyusutan/churn, waktu tunda
source_original.outputs: Persamaan diferensial diskrit dan grafik simulasi akumulasi *stock*

purpose: Define stock units and flow units per time
activation_conditions: User requests Stock and Flow Modeling or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Define stock units and flow units per time
Apply stock_next equals stock plus inflows minus outflows times time_step
Represent delays and boundary constraints explicitly
Test conservation, nonnegative limits where applicable and sensitivity to step size
mathematical_requirements: Use deterministic helper or independently validated host calculation; disclose units and assumptions.
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide stock_series or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide equations or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide assumptions or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
